why: Cycle 11 of the expression area (docs/v3/cycles/expression-11.md) ran six native cases that had never run, again with no referenced case because TuffUI published nothing after `f31ea2b`. All six passed in round 0: median 85 on all items (the R items and the rendering cap applied for the first time and capped no case), minimum 82; on F, K and X 84 and 81; on the F and K items 86.5, the best of eleven cycles. No P1 and two P2 (n47's and n50's F6: an `IntervalTrack` label cut to 'Lead…' and a block reason cut at 390, a clamped '$63.1' drawn unreadable with the axis hover readout on a tick). It met every convergence clause it could measure for the second cycle; cycle 10's Decision on the referenced clause closed with its default, so the protocol stands. 41 of 60 lost points were `primitive` and 19 `skill`. No case needed repair, so hypothesis 1's median lift was 0 by construction. Its fix rows (v3-expr-11-kit-fixes, v3-expr-11-contract, v3-expr-11-skill) fix nine kit behaviours (half-width tables, the joined-row reveal, the hover readout on ticks, clamped values, rule and zone labels, labels on dimmed marks, IntervalTrack short spans, loading heights, meter values) and cycle 10's two open gaps; add, behind a Spec, coincident dots, a BarList legend switch with its exported type, a table row with no chart item in the focus and a BarList body past 10 rows; and ask why the fact count and the one-view check fail on every page. This cycle measures again on six cases that have never run. docs/v3/EXPRESSION.md is the protocol; it specialises docs/v3/CYCLES.md.

change: Follow docs/v3/EXPRESSION.md § The loop for cases n51, n52, n53, n54, n55 and n56 (all native; none has run). Before pinning, check TuffUI (github.com/yurigdesigner/tuffui) for visualization components published after `f31ea2b` (2026-11-16; cycles 7 to 11 found none); for each one, add a `c` case, its reference row and shot (`.evidence/v3-shots/expression-6/ref-shot.ts` in the main checkout shoots a page at 1440x1000 with reduced motion), and run it in place of a native case. With fewer than four referenced cases the cycle file reports the convergence clause on the referenced cases it has and says the clause cannot be met in full; with none, the verdict counts are empty. You are the lead: you spawn, shoot, collect and diagnose; you build nothing and score nothing. (1) Builders: one fresh subagent per case on the default worker tier, with the case row verbatim, the scenario id `expr-<case id>`, and the fence of cycle 11 (its builder prompt, `.evidence/v3-shots/expression-11/builder-prompt.md` in the main checkout, is the model; its lead tools are in the same directory). Pre-register the registry and scenario-info entries with placeholders so each builder owns one directory, run oxfmt on scenario-info.ts after adding them, and tell builders that `fixture` reaches the scenario as a prop. Each builder builds into its own dist directory and shoots its own route. (2) Shoot each scenario with apps/playground/scripts/shots.ts, plus the keyboard, list, reach and sweep frames and the BOX readings of cycle 11's lead tool (`lead-shots.ts` with `shoot-round.sh`). (3) Reviewers: one fresh subagent per case and round, never the builder, with the case row, the shot paths, a snapshot of the scenario source for that round, docs/v3/expression/rubric.md and the shoot log. Tell it to open every shot. (4) Repair: hand a case that scored under 80 its reviewer's findings, at most two more rounds, shooting and scoring after each. (5) Diagnose every point lost in round 0 into one class from EXPRESSION.md § Finding classes, using the builder's wish list and its workaround comments as evidence. Where an open plan row already owns a gap, class the finding `planned` and append it as a `notes` entry to that row's brief instead of filing a row. (6) Judge the three hypotheses against EXPRESSION.md § Thresholds, using this cycle's numbers and the verdict lines of docs/v3/spikes/viz-census.md; for hypothesis 1, report the per-case lift of the cases that were repaired beside the median lift, and say when no case was repaired. (7) File per CYCLES.md step 6. A fix that adds a public export, changes charts/contract.ts or changes what primitive-bypass denies is one row with `checkpoint: spec` and seat opus high. Report factory friction with `factory signal file`, not as a row. Lead notes from cycle 11: (a) check v3-expr-11-kit-fixes before round 0 on a build of the pinned master: n45, n46, n47, n49 and n50 at 1800 with the table beside the chart (does a half-width table keep its columns), n45's and n47's focus frames (is the joined row in view), n49's and n50's sweep frames (the hover readout against the ticks), n46 `?fixture=burst` and n50 rest (clamped values), n45 `?fixture=quiet` and n46 at 390 (rule and zone labels), n46's and n47's focus frames (labels on dimmed marks), n47 rest and `?fixture=stalled` and n48 at 390 (IntervalTrack labels, widths and coincident points), n46, n48 and n49 loading against rest, n49's meter values, a framed table's header in empty and error (n47, n48, n49) and n42's phone-card sweep at 390; if any did not land, tell builders so the same gap does not cost twice; (b) check v3-expr-11-contract: tell reviewers what the Spec ruled and which fields shipped; (c) check v3-expr-11-skill; (d) run `make check-fast` on the round-0 tree before round 1 starts, never while a builder edits; cycle 11's run failed once in the quality matrix on `/kit/split` (a ring clipped by main) and passed when the matrix ran again, so rerun the matrix alone before reading a red as the branch's; (e) keep cycle 11's reviewer notes on the two sanctioned colour forms, the LIST approach, the REACH and BOX lines and the shipped fields; (f) keep the builder prompt's line to look at the page the way the skill's last step says, without naming the keys state, and count who shot a keyboard frame (cycle 11: 6 of 6); (g) `demo/series.ts` is shared: tell builders to change only their own group with one Edit after a fresh Read and never to rewrite the file, and to run `bun test` on its own; (h) once this cycle runs, the bank's only never-run cases are the ones it adds: add at least five from pages no case covers yet, so cycle 13 can draw six, and say so; (i) report every score on all items, on F, K and X without the R items and the cap, and, for the trend against cycles 1 and 2, on the F and K items alone; (j) read each LIST, REACH and SWEEP line against its frame and tell the reviewer what it hovered; (k) the builder prompt fences writes to the case directory, while the skill writes its fact-count and one-view tables to docs/design/<screen>.md: let builders write that file as `DESIGN.md` in their case directory, so X1 and X2 measure the step, not the fence; (l) an Agent call from a REPL script resolves to a launch receipt, not the worker's report: save each builder's report from its last message, not from the call's value; (m) cycles 10 and 11 met every convergence clause they could measure, and the referenced clause cannot be met while no `c` case can run: if this cycle meets the measurable clauses again, say so in the convergence section, and if the owner has ruled on the question by then, apply the ruling.
